issueSummary.value: SafeLife Insurance rejected a father's health insurance claim for a ₹1,85,000 hospital bill, citing pre-existing diabetes he says was declared.

entityType.evidence: health insurance claim with SafeLife Insurance

insurer_complaint.en:
SUBJECT: Request to review rejected health claim of ₹1,85,000 – Policy No. [POLICY NUMBER]

DESCRIPTION:
Dear Grievance Officer,

I am writing about the health insurance claim for my father, [FATHER'S FULL NAME], under policy number [POLICY NUMBER]. The claim dated 28 Oct 2026 was for a hospital bill of ₹1,85,000. Claim number: [CLAIM NUMBER].

SafeLife Insurance rejected this claim, citing pre-existing diabetes. My father declared his diabetes to you. I believe the rejection is not correct.

I raised this verbally with your team on [DATE OF VERBAL COMPLAINT]. The claim was still rejected.

Under the Insurance Ombudsman Rules 2017 (as amended), a policyholder must first complain to the insurer in writing. This is my formal written complaint. Please review the claim again, looking at the declaration my father made.

Please send me a written reply and a complaint reference number.

Regards,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[RELATIONSHIP TO POLICYHOLDER]
[MOBILE NUMBER]
[EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Review the rejection of the claim of ₹1,85,000 again.
2. Settle the claim under the policy terms, since my father declared his diabetes.
3. If you keep the rejection, give the full reasons in writing.
4. Send a copy of the proposal form and any declaration records you hold.
5. Give me a complaint reference number for this complaint.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Policy document or policy schedule
- Proposal form or other proof that diabetes was declared
- Claim rejection letter or message
- Hospital bills and discharge summary
- Claim form and claim number details
- Notes of the verbal complaint (date, name of staff, if known)
insurer_complaint.hi:
SUBJECT: स्वास्थ्य बीमा दावा (₹1,85,000) अस्वीकार किए जाने पर लिखित शिकायत: पॉलिसी संख्या [POLICY NUMBER]

DESCRIPTION:
सेवा में,
शिकायत निवारण विभाग, SafeLife Insurance

मैं [YOUR FULL NAME] यह शिकायत अपने पिता [FATHER'S FULL NAME] के स्वास्थ्य बीमा दावे के बारे में लिख रहा/रही हूँ। पॉलिसी संख्या [POLICY NUMBER] और दावा संख्या [CLAIM NUMBER] है।

यह दावा 28 अक्टूबर 2026 से संबंधित है। अस्पताल का बिल ₹1,85,000 था। SafeLife Insurance ने यह दावा पहले से मौजूद डायबिटीज़ का कारण बताकर अस्वीकार कर दिया।

मेरे पिता का कहना है कि उन्होंने पॉलिसी लेते समय अपनी डायबिटीज़ की जानकारी दी थी। इसलिए यह अस्वीकृति उचित नहीं लगती।

मैंने पहले इस बारे में मौखिक शिकायत की थी, पर उसे भी अस्वीकार कर दिया गया। Insurance Ombudsman Rules 2017 (as amended) के अनुसार पहले बीमा कंपनी से लिखित शिकायत करनी होती है। इसी नियम के तहत मैं यह लिखित शिकायत दे रहा/रही हूँ।

कृपया मेरी शिकायत पर दोबारा विचार करें।

[YOUR FULL NAME]
[MOBILE NUMBER]
[EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. दावा अस्वीकृति की दोबारा समीक्षा की जाए और पॉलिसी की शर्तों के अनुसार ₹1,85,000 के दावे का निपटान किया जाए।
2. यदि दावा फिर भी अस्वीकार हो, तो लिखित कारण बताया जाए। साथ ही वे दस्तावेज़ भी दिए जाएँ जिनके आधार पर फैसला लिया गया।
3. इस शिकायत की प्राप्ति की पुष्टि शिकायत संदर्भ संख्या के साथ दी जाए।

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- पॉलिसी दस्तावेज़ की प्रति
- प्रपोज़ल फॉर्म की प्रति, जिसमें डायबिटीज़ की जानकारी दी गई है
- दावा अस्वीकृति पत्र या ईमेल
- अस्पताल के बिल और डिस्चार्ज समरी
- पिता और आपका पहचान पत्र

bima_bharosa.en:
SUBJECT: Escalation: SafeLife Insurance rejected health claim of ₹1,85,000 over declared pre-existing diabetes

DESCRIPTION:
I am [YOUR FULL NAME]. I am writing about my father's health insurance claim with SafeLife Insurance.

Policyholder: [POLICYHOLDER NAME]
Policy number: [POLICY NUMBER]
Claim number: [CLAIM NUMBER]
Claim amount: ₹1,85,000
Claim date: 28 Oct 2026

My father was hospitalised, and the hospital bill was ₹1,85,000. SafeLife Insurance rejected the claim. They said the reason was pre-existing diabetes. My father states that he declared his diabetes when he took the policy.

I raised this with SafeLife Insurance verbally on [DATE OF VERBAL COMPLAINT]. They rejected my complaint.

I am now escalating this through IRDAI's Bima Bharosa portal, as allowed under IRDAI Bima Bharosa. I request a fair review of this rejection.

[YOUR FULL NAME]
[PHONE NUMBER]
[EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Direct SafeLife Insurance to review the claim rejection, taking into account the declaration of diabetes made when the policy was taken.
2. Ask SafeLife Insurance to give the reasons for rejection in writing, with the specific policy clause it relied on.
3. If the claim is found payable, direct SafeLife Insurance to settle the claim of ₹1,85,000.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Policy document and proposal form showing the diabetes declaration
- Claim rejection letter or message from SafeLife Insurance
- Hospital bills, discharge summary and medical records
- Claim form as submitted
- Notes of the verbal complaint (date, time and person spoken to, if known)
- ID proof of the policyholder

insurance_ombudsman.en:
SUBJECT: Complaint against SafeLife Insurance for rejecting a ₹1,85,000 health insurance claim

DESCRIPTION:
I am [YOUR FULL NAME], writing about my father, [FATHER'S FULL NAME]. He holds a SafeLife Insurance health policy, number [POLICY NUMBER].

We made a claim for his hospital bill of ₹1,85,000. The claim is dated 28 Oct 2026. SafeLife Insurance rejected it, citing pre-existing diabetes. My father declared his diabetes when he took the policy, so this reason is not valid.

I first raised this with SafeLife Insurance verbally. I then complained in writing on [DATE OF WRITTEN COMPLAINT TO INSURER], reference [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]. The insurer rejected my complaint on [DATE OF INSURER'S REJECTION].

Under the Insurance Ombudsman Rules 2017 (as amended), I may approach the Insurance Ombudsman after the insurer rejects a written complaint. I am filing within one year of the insurer's decision, as these Rules require. The amount claimed is within the Insurance Ombudsman's limit of ₹50 lakh under the same Rules.

I request a fair review of this rejection.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Direct SafeLife Insurance to settle the claim of ₹1,85,000.
2. Direct SafeLife Insurance to show where it says the diabetes was not declared.
3. Any other relief the Ombudsman finds fair.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Policy document and proposal form showing the declared diabetes
- Claim form and hospital bills of ₹1,85,000
- Discharge summary and medical records
- SafeLife Insurance's claim rejection letter
- Copy of my written complaint to SafeLife Insurance
- SafeLife Insurance's reply to my complaint
- ID proof, and proof of my relationship to my father
